topic: University tuition fees for working students in adapted-schedule public programmes (Rabat)
scale: Sit-in (7 pm, Oct 21) and demonstration (11 am, Oct 22) outside Parliament in Rabat by the National Coordination of Civil Servants and Employees Subject to Adapted Study Schedules; no turnout figure stated in the sources
quote1: Working students and public-sector employees enrolled in university programmes with adapted schedules are protesting the fees associated with their studies.
quote2: The group announced demonstrations outside Parliament in Rabat on October 21 and 22, 2026, calling for an end to the disputed charges and renewed protection of the principle of free public higher education.
